name: argus-desk
description: A review desk inside Claude Code: every outward reply is filed, checked against the live thread, and sent only on the operator's Send; Deny and Modify are recorded for the economics.

stateDir.title: State directory
stateDir.description: Where the desk keeps its ledger, checks and decisions.

pollMinutes.title: Poll every (minutes)
pollMinutes.description: How often the desk searches for open tickets and pulls the next one; 0 turns polling off.

readProxy.title: Read proxy
readProxy.description: invoke_proxy proxy for ticket reads (search, ticket, comments).

writeProxy.title: Write proxy
writeProxy.description: invoke_proxy proxy the model is told to post through.

searchQuery.title: Search query
searchQuery.description: Zendesk search for the tickets the desk should work. status<pending is new and open.

commentsEndpoint.title: Comments endpoint
commentsEndpoint.description: invoke_proxy endpoint that lists a ticket's comments.

ticketEndpoint.title: Ticket endpoint
ticketEndpoint.description: invoke_proxy endpoint that reads one ticket.

updateEndpoint.title: Update endpoint
updateEndpoint.description: invoke_proxy endpoint that posts a comment and sets the status.

sendStatus.title: Status on Send
sendStatus.description: The ticket status the Send button sets with the reply: pending, solved, open or on-hold.

outwardTool.title: Outward tool name
outwardTool.description: Substring of the tool name that can post to the ticketing console.

docsHosts.title: Documentation hosts
docsHosts.description: Comma-separated hosts whose pages may back a docs receipt.

investigatorModel.title: Investigator model
investigatorModel.description: Model alias or id for this role's subagents.

adversaryModel.title: Adversary model
adversaryModel.description: Model alias or id for this role's subagents.

drafterModel.title: Drafter model
drafterModel.description: Model alias or id for this role's subagents.

reviewerModel.title: Reviewer model
reviewerModel.description: Model alias or id for this role's subagents.

maxRounds.title: Review rounds
maxRounds.description: How many times the drafter revises after reviewer objections before the draft goes to the operator (0 to 3).

docsTool.title: Docs search tool
docsTool.description: The session tool the investigators use for documentation (its result is captured so a docs receipt can quote it); empty turns the docs leg off.

docsSource.title: Docs data source
docsSource.description: The data source the investigators are told to search for documentation.
